conbody.p: Four tiles give the share of requirements traced and verified, how many tests are failing and how many links are suspect; each opens the page behind its number. Needs you lists what waits on the team: reviews, suspect links, test runs in progress, failing tests, unread comments and the changes agents have proposed (see Home in the project pages chapter for each kind of line). Recent activity shows the newest events, and Full history opens the Activity page.
